summary: Initializes an audio mixer device on this: if the global mixer pointer dword_8AC4C8 is already set, or if the init-status global dword_8AC4C4 is non-null (in which case the mixer is created through the vtable+96 dispatch and its volume set through the vtable+28 dispatch with the float at flt_7CF380), then marks this+0x10 as active (1), resets the state at this+0x14 to 0, and re-applies the volume through the vtable+28 dispatch. Returns 0 when creation was not performed or failed. Called by ConditionalSoundRenderDispatchOnParamCheck, sub_485B90 and SystemOSAPICall.

operations.description: Short-circuit guard: proceed to the field-initialization body if the mixer pointer dword_8AC4C8 is already non-null, or if dword_8AC4C4 is non-null AND the creation/setup below leaves dword_8AC4C8 non-zero; otherwise return the result unchanged.
Create the mixer instance: dword_8AC4C8 = (vtable+96)(dword_8AC4C4), dispatching through the vtable method pointer at offset 96 on the init-status object.
Set the initial volume: (vtable+28)(dword_8AC4C8, flt_7CF380), dispatching the vtable method at offset 28 on the new mixer with the float value from flt_7CF380.
Mark the device active: write byte 1 to this+0x10.
Reset the fade/transition state: write dword 0 to this+0x14.
Re-apply the volume with (vtable+28)(dword_8AC4C8, flt_7CF380) as the return value; when the guard fails, return the previously captured result instead.
